_comment: Renewal / final-expiration emails sent by the send-renewal-email.yml GitHub workflow (MorphoCloudWorkflow, vendorized to Instances). The workflow fetches this file, substitutes {{placeholders}}, and sends via convert_markdown. Placeholders: {{instance_name}} {{volume_name}} {{days_until_expiration}} {{issue_number}} {{repo}} {{repo_name}}. Edit here; changes are live on the next workflow run (no re-vendorize needed).
renewal_available_subject: [{{repo_name}}] Instance {{instance_name}} and Volume {{volume_name}} Scheduled for Deletion
renewal_available_body:
## 🚨 Urgent: Your MorphoCloud Instance & Volume Will Be Deleted in {{days_until_expiration}} Days

Your MorphoCloud instance **{{instance_name}}** and its associated volume **{{volume_name}}** are scheduled for **permanent deletion** in **{{days_until_expiration}}** days.

**This action is irreversible.** If you need to retain your instance and volume, you **must renew before the deadline** by commenting `/renew` on [Issue #{{issue_number}}](https://github.com/{{repo}}/issues/{{issue_number}}).

## 🔄 How to Renew
1️⃣ Open [Issue #{{issue_number}}](https://github.com/{{repo}}/issues/{{issue_number}})
2️⃣ Add a new comment: **`/renew`**
3️⃣ If additional lifespan is available, your instance will be extended.

**🔴 If no renewal is requested, your instance and volume will be permanently deleted in {{days_until_expiration}} days.**

## ❓ Need Help?

Contact us at [portal@morphocloud.org](mailto:portal@morphocloud.org) if you have any questions.

**⏳ Time is running out! If you wish to keep your instance and volume, comment `/renew` now!**
final_notice_subject: [{{repo_name}}] FINAL NOTICE: Instance {{instance_name}} and Volume {{volume_name}} Will Be Deleted
final_notice_body:
## 🚨 FINAL NOTICE: Your MorphoCloud Instance & Volume Will Be Permanently Deleted in {{days_until_expiration}} Days

Your MorphoCloud instance **{{instance_name}}** and its associated volume **{{volume_name}}** are scheduled for **permanent deletion** in **{{days_until_expiration}}** days.

**⚠️ IMPORTANT: This instance has already been renewed and NO FURTHER RENEWALS ARE POSSIBLE.**

**This action is irreversible.** Please ensure you:
1. **Back up all important data immediately** from your instance and volume
2. Download any files or results you need to keep

**🔴 Your instance and volume will be permanently deleted in {{days_until_expiration}} days. There is no way to extend this deadline.**

## 🆕 Need a New Instance?

After your current instance is deleted, you can request a new instance by opening a new issue in this repository.

## ❓ Need Help?

Contact us at [portal@morphocloud.org](mailto:portal@morphocloud.org) if you have any questions.

**⏳ Time is running out! Back up your data now!**
